examples.name: Default
examples.summary: One date in a field: the trigger shows the picked day, the panel holds the month grid, a typed date field and Apply.

examples.name: Horizontal
examples.summary: `orientation="horizontal"` places the date and time fields and Apply beside the month grid, with a full-height divider.

examples.name: MinMax
examples.summary: `min` and `max` disable the days outside a window two months either side of the reference day.

examples.name: WithTime
examples.summary: `show-time` adds a time field (type a time or pick one from the 30-minute list), so the value carries a time of day; the trigger shows it after the date.

examples.name: Clearable
examples.summary: `clearable` adds a clear control on the trigger that empties the committed date.

examples.name: Disabled
examples.summary: `disabled` locks the trigger and keeps the committed date visible.

examples.name: ClearPart
examples.summary: `DatePicker.Clear` in the `footer` slot empties the draft date inside the panel.
